inspiration.observed_pattern: MariaDB compares row constructors against a list of row constructors with IN, including ordinary equality and NULL-sensitive membership cases.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored dispatch-lane membership report. A two-column ROW constructor is tested against two fixed lane tuples, with one unmatched row and a separate NULL-containing tuple list to expose SQL three-valued row membership; the source table, values, and test expressions are not copied.

fixture_notes: Dispatch rows 701 and 702 match the north/1 and south/2 tuple list, row 703 is not listed, and row 704 has a NULL lane number so the NULL-containing candidate list yields SQL NULL rather than a false match.
determinism_notes: All dispatch IDs, lane values, tuple candidates, and output ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE dispatch_lanes (dispatch_id INT PRIMARY KEY, region_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, lane_no INT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT dispatch_id, ROW(region_code, lane_no) IN (ROW('north', 1), ROW('south', 2)) AS listed_lane, ROW(region_code, lane_no) IN (ROW('north', 1), ROW('north', NULL)) AS nullable_lane FROM dispatch_lanes ORDER BY dispatch_id
